title: lycopodium complanatum subsp. montellii
intro: Lycopodium complanatum subsp. montellii, commonly known as the Montell's club moss, is a type of plant belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family, characterized by its small, branching stems and needle-like leaves. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium complanatum subsp. montellii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
